Lojban short stories from the book “Novelas Cortas” by [[wikipedia:Pedro Antonio de Alarcón|Pedro Antonio de Alarcón]] edited with notes and vocabulary by W.F. Giese, published by Ginn & company, 1906. [http://librivox.org/novelas-cortas-by-pedro-antonio-de-alarcon/ LibriVox] recording read by [http://www.karenrsavage.com/blog/ Karen Savage]. For intermediate learners.

Readers might consider to open separate browser windows for the main text, the notes, the audio player, and/or the vocabulary in order to avoid excessive jumping within one window.
